summary: Frontend mobile preview tested through setup, singles/doubles selection, toss, live scoring, due controls, queen scoring, board history, rules modal, persistence reload, and landscape layout.

issues: No interactive or critical element exposes a data-testid; automated accessibility/regression targeting is unavailable.

action_items: Add stable testID props to controls, inputs, header actions, modal/link, and reset confirmation.
Use actual player/team names in completed-board history instead of hardcoded Team 1/Team 2.
Make theme toggle change the rendered palette; themeDark currently only changes the icon.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/.env provides EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, not EXPO_BACKEND_URL; any future API integration must use the configured public environment value.
Header actions have icon-only Pressables without accessibility labels.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same-context reload restores active match via AsyncStorage; isolated context starts setup as expected. Landscape 844x390 has no horizontal overflow.
rca_of_issue: History hardcodes labels in History(): b.winner === 'A' ? 'Team 1' : 'Team 2', rather than using match names. Theme state is toggled but never used in styles. testID props are absent throughout index.tsx.
